author: InputIGNHere
body:
Hello folks!

The Officials team would like to open up Referee applications as we have open spots for new refs!

Please submit your application to the subforum "Ref/Streamer Applications" with he following format:

IGN:
Discord(ex. Name#1234):
Timezone:
Why would you like to join the referee team(brief paragraph):
Best time of the week?:
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself(Pretend you are trying to sell yourself to us):
Anything else?:

No troll apps please.
Apps will be open for 2 weeks(Til June 22nd, 2017) :D.
We will begin responding to applications starting the 22nd.
Any questions? Please direct them towards {tag=6a81760ce56942099de44e6f636ab030} or {tag=bff56e079469477281be84fc627ea113}

Best of luck!
-Input
